prompts.name: aurum
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a polished square 2 by 2 photographic collage for a portfolio brand board for Aurum. Input image is the reference logo artwork, preserve its symbol and spelling as closely as possible. Four equal square panels, narrow white gutters: three realistic branded applications (premium business cards, presentation folder, embossed notebook) and one abstract material/detail photograph inspired by the logo. Palette: black, electric blue, warm ivory. Soft editorial studio lighting, tactile materials, clean sophisticated art direction, lively but restrained. No extra slogans, no invented contact information, no watermarks, no board headings or color swatches. This is concept imagery, not an actual client product photo.
